author: Tripo AI (Tripo3D) model generated by the game owner; prepared for the remake by Stjörnufar
license: Tripo3D output generated on the owner's paid Tripo plan, used under Tripo terms
rightsNote: The owner generated this model on a paid Tripo plan (see dist/assets/dinosaurs/TRIPO-NOTE.txt). Keep a copy of the Tripo terms in force at publication.
decisions: The owner kept the model's terracotta (not the style guide's violet) and chose real sizes: Grameðla is 12 m nose to tail (2026-10-15; STYLE.md section 3).
modifications: Unrigged Tripo export in 17 parts (389,866 triangles, three 2048 px textures: base colour, metal/roughness, normal map; one double-sided material), standing on both feet turned 45 degrees. Welded across UV seams and the seams between parts (47 edges split at T-junctions, 9 pinholes filled; Tripo's seams had hairline cracks and normals that disagreed by up to 33 degrees across the back of the neck, the thin dark line on her back, and 150 at the lips), decimated as one mesh with the head keeping relatively more detail and the lower jaw's seam kept as Tripo made it, and split back into its 17 parts: 37,600 triangles, closed (remake/tools/blender-decimate.py ... parts keep=tripo_part_7, Blender 5.2; kept as source/trex-parts.glb). Baked by remake/tools/bake/bake-tailed-biped.js (run with bake-character.mjs): turned to face +X (128.6 degrees, from the footprint and the left/right pairs), scaled to 12 m long (5.22 m high), stood on the ground with the origin between the feet, rigged with 27 bones, smooth skin weights agreeing across the seams, the front of the lip seam opened with a mouth pocket (1,708 triangles, palate and tongue painted into a free corner of the colour map), three clips authored in code (tailed-biped-clips.js), merged into one skinned mesh with one matte single-sided material (roughness 0.62, no metalness, normal map at 0.8), base colour (no recolour) and normal map as 1024 px JPEG, the metal/roughness map dropped.
rig: Our bake tool for tailed bipeds. Bones: root, Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, Jaw, Tail1-Tail6, Left/Right Thigh, Shin, Metatarsus, Foot (digitigrade; Foot is the ball of the foot and carries the toes), Left/Right UpperArm, LowerArm, Hand; identity rest rotations. Clips: idle 4.0 s; walk 2.5 s, 2.8 m a cycle (1.12 m/s; a planted foot sweeps back at exactly that speed, duty 0.62); roar 3.6 s (jaw open up to 26 degrees, no teeth, a happy head shake); the feet stay planted in idle and roar. The clips straighten most of the tail's sideways bend at its root.
pose: Rest pose on both feet, head and tail level, short arms clear of the body; turned 45 degrees (faces the -X+Z diagonal); 1.33 units long, 0.56 high.
lookCheck: qa/remake/shots/trex-bake/ (chapter=lineup: next to Mosi and Egill; roar, walk, face, neck) and qa/remake/shots/trex-look/ (the source as received).
